subject.title: feat(plugins): add cron reconciliation lifecycle hook

question: Should OpenClaw adopt `cron_reconciled` as a permanent public Plugin SDK lifecycle contract for external scheduler projection plugins?
rationale: Source review supports the implementation, but accepting a new public hook and its long-term compatibility obligation requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept the dedicated hook
options.body: Adopt the minimal observation-only contract after real external-plugin proof and normal merge-state cleanup.

options.title: Keep existing hooks only
options.body: Reject the new API and require external schedulers to use `gateway_start` plus `cron_changed` despite their weaker baseline semantics.

recommendation.title: Accept the dedicated hook
recommendation.body: Adopt the minimal observation-only contract after real external-plugin proof and normal merge-state cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history connects this owner to the Gateway startup, reload, and plugin-hook surfaces, and the PR is described as maintainer-directed.
